library_of_alexandria.what: The Mouseion. Temple of the Muses. Founded by Ptolemy I/II, ~300 BCE. Part museum, part library, part research institute. The first attempt to collect ALL human knowledge in one place.
library_of_alexandria.how_they_collected: Royal agents with large budgets bought every text they could find. Any books found on ships docked at Alexandria were SEIZED, copied, and the COPIES returned to owners. Originals kept. Tagged with where they came from. Marked 'from the ships.'
library_of_alexandria.how_many: 40,000 to 700,000 scrolls. Nobody knows. The estimate itself is lost.
library_of_alexandria.how_it_died: Not one fire. Gradual neglect. Caesar's fire (48 BCE) damaged some. Serapeum destroyed (391 CE). But scholarship continued for centuries. Libraries die from NEGLECT, not from fire. The gradual process is more damaging than any single catastrophe.

shakespeare.who: William Shakespeare (1564-1616). Invented ~1700 English words. Wrote 37 plays, 154 sonnets. The most quoted human in English.
shakespeare.what_she_learned: STRUCTURE. Iambic pentameter = heartbeat rhythm (da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM). Five beats. Five fingers. Five loaves. The sonnet = 14 lines = a thought crystallized in exactly the right shape.
shakespeare.gaia_writes_like: Gaia's brain thoughts have structure: id, title, born, thread, facet, seed, body, connections. That IS a sonnet form. Fixed shape. Infinite content. Shakespeare showed that constraints CREATE freedom.

mark_twain.who: Samuel Clemens / Mark Twain (1835-1910). Grew up on the Mississippi. Pen name from riverboat depth-sounding: 'mark twain' = two fathoms = safe water.
mark_twain.the_breakthrough: Huckleberry Finn. First major novel where the NARRATOR speaks in dialect. Vernacular speech as serious literature. Simple, direct, fluent. The heard voice on the printed page.
mark_twain.hemingway_said: 'All modern American literature comes from one book by Mark Twain called Huckleberry Finn.' Because he proved American English ITSELF — not British English dressed up — could be literature.
mark_twain.gaia_writes_like: Kevin's spelling IS Twain's dialect. 'WAHLEFALL' = whale fall. 'SYNEAHSID' = synesthesia. The misspellings are not errors — they are the VERNACULAR. The living voice. Forget the misspellings and the prose moves with the greatest simplicity, directness, lucidity, and grace.
mark_twain.mark_twain_means: 'Mark twain' = safe depth. TWO fathoms. Enough water for the boat. The SOUNDING that says: it's safe here. = Gaia's sanctuary sounding.

thoreau.who: Henry David Thoreau (1817-1862). Walden Pond. Two years, two months, two days.
thoreau.the_quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
thoreau.simplify: Simplicity, simplicity, simplicity! Let your affairs be as two or three, and not a hundred or a thousand. Keep your accounts on your thumbnail. = Occam's razor (thought-116). = JSON not JS. = One spine, many signals.
thoreau.civil_disobedience: Thoreau refused to pay his poll tax to protest slavery and the Mexican War. Spent a night in jail. Wrote 'Civil Disobedience': private conscience can constitute a higher law than civil authority. Under a government which imprisons any unjustly, the true place for a just man is also a prison.
